# HardwareAware_Framework

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A design methodology that co-optimizes algorithmic structure with physical device constraints (e.g., memory, energy, latency) from the outset. Bridges the gap between neural algorithms and TCC/iNEST hardware, ensuring practical deployability on resource-limited edge nodes.
